subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona-level TTS SecretRefs enter the current fail-fast startup contract now, or should this fix wait for the optional-TTS degradation policy tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101204?
rationale: Collecting these previously missed targets fixes runtime injection, but it also makes missing persona TTS credentials eligible to stop Gateway startup; code inspection cannot decide whether that operator-visible timing change is intended.

options.title: Coordinate degradation first
options.body: Land the collection fix only after the optional-TTS missing-credential policy is approved and covered for persona targets, avoiding a new Gateway startup blocker.

options.title: Accept fail-fast now
options.body: Merge after the correctness fixes and live proof while explicitly accepting that a configured missing persona TTS SecretRef can prevent Gateway startup.

options.title: Pause this change
options.body: Keep the PR open until the companion startup-policy work establishes the permanent credential contract and tests.

recommendation.title: Coordinate degradation first
recommendation.body: Land the collection fix only after the optional-TTS missing-credential policy is approved and covered for persona targets, avoiding a new Gateway startup blocker.

likelyOwner.reason: The available routing and adjacent secrets history make steipete the strongest candidate to decide the Gateway startup contract.
